title: Chapter 166
text:
In a stronghold of the Dark Net Organization.

"Black Phantom went to the Western Continent? Where did he go? "Bennett was surprised.

"I don't know. He didn't say." Wang Yuan shook his head.

Bennett had no choice but to give Han Xiao a call, but it did not go through. Han Xiao was on a cross-ocean flight, so the signal was not good.

Bennett was helpless. He had already received the material aid from Stardragon, and Hesla had also relented after some negotiations. The sanctuary plan was going to be tested in the Southern Continent, and he was preparing to gather the strongest in the organization to protect the first step of the plan. Black Phantom was one of the first three invitees on the list, but before he could inform him, Han Xiao had already slipped away to the Western Continent.

The location of the first sanctuary had already been chosen — it was in the ruins of a big city in the wilderness.

Bennett suddenly had an idea. "Maple rejected the material aid. Those bureaucrats are only amenable to force. Since Black Phantom has gone to the Western Continent, I'll let him make a statement for me!"

…

There was no light source in the confinement room. The thick metal door isolated the outside world, and only a sliver of light could be seen in the darkness. Elux curled up in a corner and looked at the interface. He wanted to cry, but no tears came out. His Esper Ability was rated as Grade A, but after more than twenty days of the open beta, when the average player had reached LV 8, his Esper Ability was still at LV 1.

The Germinal Organization said that they would lock him up for a month, and they really meant it. If not for the fact that Elux did not want to give up his Esper Ability with high potential, he would have changed his account. The club was very concerned when they found out about his account situation. They asked Elux to be patient and promised to invest resources in him after he was released. That was why he was able to persevere and continue to be online every day, hoping for a change.

At this time, the metal door slowly opened, and white light shone in.

Elux looked up and saw a Caucasian man in a white coat standing outside the door. He stared at Elux as if he was looking at a rare treasure.

"I want to do a little test for you." The man in the white coat smiled nervously.

…

Cyberlos was very happy.

He was one of the upper echelons of the Germinal Organization, and he was also a biological scientist. He had been conducting all kinds of experiments for the Germinal Organization for many years. Before joining the Germinal Organization, Cyberlos was a senior researcher who defected to Raylan. Raylan was full of crazy people, and his mind was filled with all kinds of crazy ideas. As a human, he had never been able to restrain his passion for dissecting the bodies of his own kind. He did not care about the difference between factions, and as long as someone funded his research, he would join that person. In the end, he was absorbed by the Germinal Organization.

Therefore, the Germinal Organization provided resources and supported Cyberlos to put all kinds of crazy ideas into experiments. He was the person in charge of the Valkyries, super soldiers, genetic modification, and other unethical projects. There were also other darker experiments. Just the mention of the names was enough to make normal people feel disgusted and perverted people feel excited, such as cross-species breeding, human-beast fusion …

After many years of research, Cyberlos had conducted no less than a hundred experiments and seen thousands of "human subjects" with special talents. Among them, only two "subjects" attracted Cyberlos' interest, and they were both Espers.

One of them had an incredible healing effect, and it could even make a dried corpse look alive again. However, without a soul, it could not be revived. This was also the first time Cyberlos knew about the existence of souls. He had been researching enthusiastically for a long time, but unfortunately, Blue Star's technology tree was not compatible, so he did not use any experimental methods to collect any souls.

The other person had some kind of ability to "influence fate". By commenting on something, it could affect the cause and effect of that thing. This was the weirdest ability Cyberlos had ever seen, and it was even more difficult to explain than souls. The ability could only be activated when the person was conscious. He had tried to hypnotize them, but it was ineffective. This person was locked up twenty-four hours a day and wore a mask that prevented him from speaking. Due to negligence, many terrible accidents had happened. The most recent accident happened more than a year ago. This person said that disaster would befall the Germinal Organization, and it came true. Now, the organization was indeed badly damaged.

Electrolux was the third subject that attracted his interest.

Cyberlos flipped through the observation diary.

Day 1: The subject was sent to the confinement room, monitored twenty-four hours a day with night vision cameras, fed three times a day, seven in the morning, eleven in the afternoon, and seven in the evening. There was no time to relax. The subject showed obvious anxiety and did not show the sluggishness after brainwashing. Initial estimation is that the subject has a certain level of immunity. A compliance test is recommended.

Day 2: At eight in the morning, a compliance test was carried out. The test results showed that the subject showed very high compliance and passed all tests. There were no abnormalities in the lie detector. The subject has accepted the new identity after brainwashing. At eleven in the evening, there was a change. The subject disappeared into thin air. There were no traces of damage in the confinement room. A comprehensive search of the base was carried out, but the subject was not found.

Day 4: The subject appeared again without any warning. The location was the confinement room, the same as where he disappeared. Video data [Appendix -001]. We controlled the subject immediately and interrogated him about the reason for his disappearance and what happened after he disappeared. The subject said that he did not know. The interrogation was recorded in [Appendix -002]. Increase the intensity of monitoring of the target.]

…

Day 6: Hypnosis was used. The subject was talking nonsense. [Appendix -003]. At night, the subject disappeared again.

Day 8: The subject appeared again. Interrogation and hypnosis again. [Appendix -004] for details. At eight in the evening, surgery was carried out to observe the physiology. There were no abnormalities in the body structure. [Appendix -005].

…

The diary was observed for twenty-two days. Electrolux's phenomenon also appeared in some of the wanderer settlements in Andrea, which attracted the attention of the Germinal Organization. They did not announce it but observed it secretly.

Not dying, could revive, appeared out of thin air, unknown origin … It was not a big deal if it was only one person, but there were more than ten thousand people who had the same phenomenon, and the number was still rising. The leader took it very seriously and made Cyberlos the person in charge to carry out all kinds of experiments on Electrolux.

Electrolux was sandwiched in the middle by the guards and brought to an operating room. He lay on the operating table and received the mission to cooperate with the surgery. He was brainwashed in the Germinal Organization, so all the orders were compulsory missions with a certain amount of experience reward. The punishment for disobeying was very heavy.

Electrolux could only listen to the orders and feel depressed.

Cyberlos put on the surgical gown and started to operate on Electrolux's body. Electrolux received a notification that he was under anesthesia and could not move. He could only watch the knife cut on his body and realized that he was being dissected. As soon as the chest was opened, the system notification appeared.

"You died during the surgery."

Electrolux was stunned. Ten seconds later, he was revived in the room.

"What the hell? I was dissected for research?"

Electrolux was stunned. He had one less chance to revive in six days, but his experience was not deducted. Maybe it was because the cause of death was special.

This was the first time he had encountered such a situation. In the virtual online games he played before, NPCs ignored the uniqueness of the players. Many people complained about this, and some even imagined that the players would be dissected for research. He did not expect it to really happen in Galaxy.

Cyberlos observed the whole process. Electrolux's body disappeared, and he appeared alive. Everything happened out of thin air. The blood stains on the operating table were still there.

"You … No, what kind of creature are you?" Cyberlos' eyes were shining.
